Compute stability meta-metric for a statistic

Source: R/models_eval.R
stat_stability.Rd

Stability measures how consistently a statistic persists across seasons for the same team/player. Higher stability means the stat is more predictable year-over-year.

Usage

stat_stability(
  df,
  entity_col = "team",
  value_col = "value",
  season_col = "season"
)

Arguments

df

A data frame with columns: team (or player), season, value.

entity_col

Character. Name of entity column (default "team").

value_col

Character. Name of value column (default "value").

season_col

Character. Name of season column (default "season").

Value

Numeric. Stability coefficient (correlation, 0-1).

Details

Calculated as the year-over-year correlation.

See also

Other meta-analytics: compute_meta_analytics(), stat_discrimination()
